compute_bn_stats: compute and update batch normalization running mean and variance stats for a PyTorch model using a data loader
run_bn_stats_update: run compute_and_update_bn_stats on a SlowFast model with a custom data loader to recalibrate batch norm statistics
refactor_bn_helper: refactor compute_and_update_bn_stats to support configurable momentum values and device-agnostic tensor movement
review_bn_stats_function: review compute_and_update_bn_stats to verify it correctly accumulates running mean and variance across batch norm layers
test_bn_stats_computation: test compute_and_update_bn_stats by passing a dummy model with BatchNorm3d layers and a mock data loader
